verdict.rationale: E2B is sandbox infrastructure for running AI-generated code and third-party agents. A built-in assistant is a fair question for a developer platform, but the evidence shows no first-party AI assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to. Hosting external agents such as Claude Code in sandboxes, or connecting your own LLM via tool use, is an adjacent building block and not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
